tokenize_file_cli: run the preprocess CLI to tokenize a text file and save tokens as a pickle file
apply_tokenizer_batch_encode: create a function that batch-encodes lines from a text file into token IDs using a HuggingFace tokenizer
save_tensor_pickle: build a function that saves a PyTorch tensor to a pickle file, creating directories as needed
tokenize_with_normalization: run the tokenizer on a text file with optional text normalization before encoding into token IDs
tokenize_file_overwrite: refactor the tokenize_file function to overwrite existing pickle output files when the overwrite flag is set
